summary: Sprint 7B.1 Copy Trading — backend + frontend E2E tested. 27/27 backend pytest cases PASS including P0 determinism-across-restart. Frontend leaderboard, filters (search 'india', Lowest Risk chip, Verified pill), profile page (avatar/flag/bio/12-cell stats grid/gradient equity curve/monthly bars/tabs), copy lifecycle (start->pause->resume->stop with toast + CTA morph), and home 'Copy Traders' quick-action all verified end-to-end. Regression: /forex /notifications /advisor /market all render without errors.

issues: When user starts fresh (no prior copy relationship), backend still returns status:'stopped' with default settings, so the modal button shows 'Update Settings' instead of 'Start Copying'. The action itself still calls copyApi.startCopy() and the toast/CTA morph work correctly, but the button label logic in TraderProfile.tsx checks 'initial ? Update Settings : Start Copying' — since a stopped record is still returned from GET /copy, initial is truthy. Consider gating on initial.status === 'active' || 'paused' instead of !!initial.

react_native_issues.issue: Multiple warnings 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing' on login + settings sheet screens. Harmless on web preview but should be silenced by removing useNativeDriver:true from web-only code paths or wrapping in Platform.OS !== 'web'. Reference: emitted by react-native Animated on web.
Console warns "shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow". Multiple RN components still using shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset.
Console warns 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — likely inside Modal/BottomSheet used by CopySettings sheet.

action_items: (low) Fix Copy Settings sheet button label — show 'Start Copying' when relationship status is 'stopped' or missing, 'Update Settings' only when active/paused. File: /app/frontend/app/traders/[id].tsx around the CopySettingsSheet primary button.
(low) Silence RN web deprecation warnings: replace shadow* props with boxShadow, replace props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents, guard useNativeDriver behind Platform.OS !== 'web'.

(optional) Add testID props to interactive elements in /app/frontend/app/traders/index.tsx and [id].tsx (search input, sort chips, verified toggle, row press, Copy CTA, Pause/Resume/Stop, Mode buttons, Start Copying) for future test stability. Currently tests rely on text selectors which work but are fragile to i18n.
critical_code_review_comments: Determinism confirmed: _rng() seeded per-persona, generator functions are pure w.r.t. seed, _CACHE is in-process only and gets rebuilt on restart with identical output. No time.time()/uuid inside RNG path. P0 determinism-across-restart test PASSED.
PaperBroker.open_position()/close_position() return only stub 'queued' dicts — 7B.1 execution intentionally deferred to 7B.2 per problem statement. Verified.
engine.update_settings() correctly retains existing settings while only patching provided keys (verified: multiplier updated to 1.5, max_daily_loss_pct=3 retained).
list_copies() enrichment in routes.py works — /my/copies returns trader summary attached (verified: trader.name == 'Marcus Wolfe').

Small style nit: engine.py line 153 assigns float for int field max_open_trades when value comes in as float — condition is `float(v) if isinstance(v, float) or k != 'max_open_trades' else int(v)`. Reads as intended but is confusing; consider a `NUMERIC_INT_KEYS = {'max_open_trades'}` set.
traders.py file is 400 lines — under 700 threshold, acceptable. routes.py is 158 lines — clean.
MongoDB _id excluded correctly via projection {'_id': 0} in engine.get_settings and list_copies.
seed_data_creation: None. Backend uses purely deterministic in-process seeded personas. Copy relationship for demo@mfb.in was created and then cleanly stopped during the lifecycle test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For copy_trading backend tests, use test_copy_trading_iter24.py — pass EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env. The Determinism test restarts backend via `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` and waits up to 40s. If running back-to-back, allow ~10s between full suite runs so the restart-recovery test succeeds cleanly. Login helper: POST /api/auth/login with {identifier, password} — token is in response.access_token.
rca_of_issue: No blocking issues. Only cosmetic RN web warnings and one minor UX label logic quirk documented in design_issues.
